infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Gather needs camera access so you can capture photos and stream live previews to the event host.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Gather needs microphone access to record audio with video clips.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Gather needs photo library access to save shared event photos to your camera roll.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Gather to access your camera to capture event memories.
